title.narrative: Budget Support Contract - Promoting Inclusive, Sustainable, and Resilient Agri-Food Systems in Bhutan

description.narrative:
The Overall Objective of this action is to reduce poverty in Bhutan by supporting the implementation of the RNR Sector¿s 12th Five Year Plan (FYP - 2018-2023) and 13th FYP (2023 to 2028). The Specific Objective of this action is to promote Sustainable Agri-Food System in Bhutan, contributing to a) fostering economic diversification and circularity of the RNR sector, b) Sustainable management and conservation of natural resources, and c) enhanced food and nutrition security.

This contract covers the budget support component of the Financing Agreement.
